headline: REDEMPLO growth continues as R&D spend widens net loss
summary_short: Arrowhead's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 171% y/y and 2.1% q/q to $75.3M as REDEMPLO's US launch kept building, while net loss attributable to the company widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M (-$1.36 diluted EPS) on higher R&D and SG&A spend.
summary_long: Revenue rose 2.1% q/q and 171% y/y to $75.3M on continued REDEMPLO US launch momentum (prescription volume roughly doubled; 400+ unique prescribers) plus new EC and Australian TGA authorizations. R&D rose to $198.2M (from $162.4M y/y) and SG&A to $47.1M (from $30.9M), pushing the operating loss up 20.4% q/q to $170.1M. Net loss attributable to Arrowhead widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M ($1.36 diluted loss/share), amplified by a $15.4M noncontrolling-interest allocation swing versus a $3.4M loss allocation a year earlier. Stockholders' equity fell 24.2% q/q to $465.5M. No forward guidance was given.
